title: File:The Doors 1968.JPG

desc: Photo of the rock group The Doors, from a promotional photo session in November 1966 in New York. From left: Jim Morrison, John Densmore, Robby Krieger and seated, Ray Manzarek. The photo was used on the sleeve of the single Light My Fire released in July 1967 [1].

desc: While walking around the various markets in Lyon on Sunday morning we came across this great acoustic folk band. We enjoyed them so much we had brunch at the restaurant across the street so we could keep listening.
